scope: Synthetic metadata ledger controls only; no credentials, operator ledger, providers or candidate execution

contract.actualCost: Remains null and incomplete; no bill or refund inferred.
contract.hold: Entire reservation remains committed against unchanged project and stage caps.
contract.proof: Trusted closed successful-response inventory; exact reservation/evidence bindings, unique request intents, source/pricing/closure and request/response/usage digests, observed tokens within request ceilings, integer upward-rounded maximum cost within full reservation.
contract.persistence: Append-only immutable coverage event in existing schema; latest reservation event must be billing_incomplete before first coverage. Later reservation/accounting events invalidate coverage; no automatic re-cover.
contract.snapshot: pendingBillingCount remains all unresolved reservations; coveredPendingBillingCount and blockingPendingBillingCount distinguish coverage only for explicitly opted-in connections.
contract.limitations: Hashes bind but do not authenticate provider evidence; trusted caller must establish actual request closure and valid published rates/caps. Transport ambiguity and other billable resources cannot use this proof.
